title: Small Tools - Subland Twist Drills with Morse Taper Shank for Clearance Holes and Countersinks for Countersunk Head Screws
clause_1_scope: This standard covers dimensions and other requirements for the subland twist drills with morse taper shank for producing clearance holes and countersinks for countersunk head screws M5 to M14 conforming to IS 3406 (Part I ) : 1986 'Dimensions for countersinks and counterbores: Part I Countersinks ( second revision )'.
